verdict.rationale: Raygun documents some public API surfaces: a Deployments API, source map uploads via API, and dSYM/ProGuard uploads, all authenticated with an external access token. The evidence only shows these narrow ingestion and deployment endpoints, not a general API for driving the product (querying, triaging or resolving error groups), and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of a broad documented REST API covering core workflows (error querying, status changes, exports), a machine-readable API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
